work.title: The Magic School Bus Rides Again
work.note: The Magic School Bus Rides Again é uma nova versão da série animada, lançada em 2017 pela Netflix em parceria com a Scholastic. A cena cultural serve de ponte para o foco “falar do ônibus: catch the bus (pegar o ônibus a tempo) e miss the bus (perder o ônibus)”. A referência mostra um ônibus escolar: catch the bus, miss the bus.

facts.label: Linhas do metrô
facts.sub: Nas grandes cidades dos EUA, cada linha do metrô tem uma cor ou uma letra. Saber a cor e a direção é a base para viajar sem se perder.

facts.label: Norte e sul da cidade
facts.sub: Em muitas cidades, uptown aponta para o norte e downtown para o centro. As plataformas mostram a direção do próximo trem com setas e nomes.

compare.us: In the USA, “take the red line” and “transfer” are common. “Uptown” and “downtown” show direction.

pages.title: Red line, blue line · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Monday morning in a busy subway station in Chicago. A big map hangs on the wall with colored lines. Ivy looks at the map and frowns. She is new in the city and wants to see a museum. A man named Rob stands next to her. He notices her confused face and speaks.
“Where do you want to go?” says Rob. “To the museum, please.” says Ivy. “Take the red line.” says Rob.

pages.title: Red line, blue line · 3/3
paragraphs: “Thank you. Does the train run every five minutes, or less often?” says Ivy. “Every five minutes. You will not wait long.” says Rob. Ivy takes the red line toward Uptown. She gets off at Central Station. She walks to the blue platform and waits. Three stops later, she steps out near the museum. She smiles because the trip was easy. A map and a kind person make the city simple.
